name: Four Deities Per Faction Roster Depth Map
rule: Playable Deities are now mythology gods: exactly four per faction, two male and two female; existing Lore Codex canon preserved.
factionDepth.philosophy: The roster is valuable because Deities solve different tactical problems, not because missions require specific ownership.

Defender.tacticalProblems: long survival, objective holding, hazard endurance

Battery.tacticalProblems: resource pressure, Divinity/Momentum economy, long missions

Controller.tacticalProblems: fast enemies, terrain-heavy battles, caster denial

Breaker.tacticalProblems: heavily armored enemies, shield windows, boss armor phases

Disruptor.tacticalProblems: enemy casters, elite mechanics, Momentum/Divinity denial

Artillery.tacticalProblems: large enemy groups, ranged pressure, objective zones

Guardian.tacticalProblems: boss duels, counterattack, protection under pressure

Assassin.tacticalProblems: execution-based encounters, priority targets, mobility assassinations

deitysNeedingDesignAttention.criterion: Any Deity whose live implementation still has generic basic/skill/ultimate only
deitysNeedingDesignAttention.action: Convert to unique resource, reaction, stance, execution, gear, and Divine Ascension mechanics before content lock.

deitysNeedingDesignAttention.criterion: Any faction passive still written for coordinated Deities
deitysNeedingDesignAttention.action: Rewrite mechanically for one active deity while preserving canon wording and identity.

deitysNeedingDesignAttention.criterion: Any mission copy implying Deity/multiple active deitys
deitysNeedingDesignAttention.action: Patch to one active deity and faction/Deity suitability tags.

favoredNotRequiredRule: Missions may show advantages and recommended Deities/builds, but never ownership locks.
